description:
In this episode of “I’d Like to Know”, Pastors Stephen Bohr and Daniel Miranda address three significant biblical questions dealing with prophecy and moral law.

Bible Question Answered every Tuesday at 4 PM PT on SUMtv — real Bible questions answered directly from Scripture.

02:10– What Is the Meaning of Revelation 9?
The pastors examine the symbolism of the fifth and sixth trumpets, the identity of the locust power, and how Revelation 9 fits within the broader prophetic timeline.

10:00 – Is the “One Hour” in Revelation 17:12 a Literal Time Prophecy?
When the ten kings receive authority “for one hour” with the beast, is this a prophetic time period or simply symbolic of a short duration? Scripture is compared with Scripture to determine how apocalyptic time language functions.

16:10 – Does the Sixth Commandment Forbid Self-Defense?
What is the difference between the Hebrew words harag and ratzach? Does “You shall not murder” prohibit taking a life in self-defense? The pastors also address Genesis 9:6 and the biblical foundation for capital punishment.

💬 Have a Bible question? Leave it in the comments — it may be featured in a future episode.

#Revelation9 #OneHourProphecy #Revelation17 #SixthCommandment #SelfDefenseInTheBible #CapitalPunishment #HaragVsRatzach #BibleProphecy #EndTimeEvents #TenKings #BibleQuestionAnswered #StephenBohr #SUMtv #AdventistTheology

This episode provides careful biblical interpretation of:

Revelation 9 prophecy
The ten kings of Revelation 17
The “one hour” prophecy
The Sixth Commandment
Murder vs killing in Hebrew
Capital punishment in Genesis 9:6
